name: XYZ Telecom
summary: Wholesale carrier (fixed wireless, ethernet, dark fibre, NBN backhaul), 100% Australian-owned, started 2022. Owned by Maret Group; carries Maret's DC/core infrastructure and resells MarchNet fixed wireless (AS38790). NOTE: unrelated to xyz.com.au (XYZnetworks, subscription TV).

events.details: XYZ Telecom Pty Ltd, started 2022 to serve MSPs/ISPs.
